title: TAOU Yoga Studio
specs: Blend of yoga styles including Iyengar, Katonah, Yin, Yang, and dance classes like Ballet and Modern
Massage therapy includes multiple techniques tailored to individual needs
No dress code; recommended loose-fitting pants, tank top, socks for Yang classes; socks and loose pants for dance classes
Wear comfortable, easy to move in clothing for massage and floor massage sessions
Bring journal or something to write in for TAOU signature yoga class
Studio rental accommodates up to 50+ standing guests; 28-35 yoga mats comfortably in large studio
Smaller studios fit 18 and 12 yoga mats comfortably for more intimate groups

options.detail: Unlimited regularly scheduled classes at both studios with various perks and discounts

includes: Use of yoga props (blocks, blankets, bolsters, Iyengar chairs) and bluetooth speaker included with studio rental
Massage sessions include organic massage products such as coconut oil, jojoba oil, CBD muscle rub, and essential oils for aromatherapy
blurb: TAOU provides a blend of yoga styles including Yin, Yang, Iyengar, and Katonah Yoga, as well as dance classes like Ballet and Modern. They offer massage therapy with various techniques and private yoga sessions. The studio has two locations and hosts creative events and workshops.
extraNote: Cancel class reservations at least 1 hour before start time to retain credit; late cancellations within 1 hour not returned · Cancel appointments at least 24 hours before to avoid full charge; no-shows charged full price · Massage cancellation policy: 24 hr notice required or full service price charged for late cancellations and no-shows · Memberships require minimum 2 month commitment and 30 day notice to cancel; may be frozen up to 3 months · 5-minute late policy for classes; no late entry allowed after 5 minutes
